title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall, University Of Illinois on 1973-02-22

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix‑mix recording of a classic early‑’73 show with standout Dark Star and Eyes of the World, praised for its clarity and overall performance.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the strong first set and sweet second set, singling out Dark Star (with its mysterious saw solo) and Eyes of the World as highlights. The recording is a well‑balanced stage‑mix (not a true soundboard) that captures clear vocals and instrument detail, making it an enjoyable listen despite occasional vocal phase‑cancellation quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars and emphasize superb musical moments and a clean stage‑mix; only a few low‑star comments note comparative weaknesses, so the overall weighted rating is strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stage‑mixed feed from the mains (not a true soundboard) with clear vocal presence and instrument separation; some listeners note minor phase‑cancellation on vocals but overall crisp and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid, energetic first set followed by a sweet, tightly‑grooved second set; transitions flow well and the show maintains momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is highlighted, especially the mysterious saw‑like texture at ~10:30 in Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh’s bass is praised for its presence and melodic lines, particularly on Bird Song and Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm guitar and occasional backing vocals receive positive nods; his vocal harmonies are mentioned as part of the overall vocal clarity.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (or other keyboardist) is noted for providing piano counterpoint that supports Garcia & Lesh, especially in the extended jams.
